records.name: Graphify
records.license: Apache-2.0 (License-Expression verified from the installed package metadata)
records.purpose: Turns codebases/docs into local queryable knowledge graphs for AI assistants (deterministic AST parsing, ~40 languages, no LLM calls for code).
records.integration_method: installed on the production VPS as the deploy user in an isolated venv (~/.local/share/graphify-venv, symlinked to ~/.local/bin/graphify); vendor Claude skill registered at ~/.claude/skills/graphify via `graphify install --platform claude`; first real graph built from projects/command-center (299 nodes / 818 edges, deterministic AST only, no LLM, no API key) at ~/oth-graphs/graphify-out/graph.json and queried via `graphify explain`. OTHMODE runtime has zero dependency on it (graceful absence); generated graphify-out/ is gitignored.
records.security: runs locally in a per-user venv; deterministic AST extraction used exclusively (no network, no API keys read); semantic extraction not enabled; graph outputs stored outside Git
records.othmode_usage: code/project/knowledge/evolution relationship graphs — vendor skill (implementation) + repo skill `graphify` (policy/boundary); recorded in Health as an optional capability
records.name_collision_note: the vendor skill and the repo policy skill share the name `graphify` by design: the repo skill (project scope) carries only the OTHMODE boundary rules and defers execution to the vendor skill (user scope) — resolved as MERGE in docs/SKILLS_EVOLUTION.md

records.name: WhatsApp notification transport for the MYTHOS GitHub bridge (Evolution API / WAHA / MultiWA / WaSphere)
records.repository: candidates evaluated: Evolution API, WAHA, MultiWA, WaSphere
records.purpose: Deliver one outbound plain-text message when a GitHub control task reaches COMPLETED, FAILED, BLOCKED or the bridge blocked-for-a-human condition.
records.integration_method: NOT vendored and NOT deployed. What was built is the adapter boundary: projects/mythos-ai-executor/bridge/notify/{whatsapp.js,http-json.js,providers/evolution.js,providers/generic.js}. Evolution API is implemented as the default adapter (POST /message/sendText/{instance}, apikey header) and is selected at runtime by MYTHOS_BRIDGE_WHATSAPP_PROVIDER; the layer is disabled unless explicitly configured and enabled. gh-issue-147 added providers/generic.js, a configuration-driven adapter (path / auth header / JSON body template / message-id path) so that pointing MYTHOS at ANY other HTTP WhatsApp gateway is an environment change, not a new file — its defaults reproduce the Evolution shape byte for byte and that equivalence is asserted by test. Node core only, no npm dependency, no database (the executor store convention is reused for the idempotency ledger).
dependencies: a self-hosted WhatsApp gateway reachable on a private network (not deployed)
records.maintenance: TO-VERIFY — STILL UNVERIFIED as of 2026-09-03 (gh-issue-147). Neither the 2026-09-02 run nor the gh-issue-147 run had any outbound research capability (WebSearch/WebFetch not granted, gh and curl not permitted), so upstream maintenance, licence, release cadence and memory footprint could NOT be live-verified for ANY candidate — including wa-evolution, which Issue #147 named explicitly. No candidate was adopted or recommended on unverified information.
records.security: credential read at send time from a 0600 file, never stored/logged/echoed; gateway host must be loopback/RFC1918/single-label unless MYTHOS_BRIDGE_WHATSAPP_ALLOW_PUBLIC=1; every message passes the shared redaction; recipients and instance names validated against injection. The generic adapter's body template is JSON-parsed BEFORE substitution, so untrusted text lands in a string slot and cannot inject JSON structure; its path alphabet and header name are validated and a broken template is a queue-scope readiness refusal. Proven by tests/mythos-bridge-whatsapp-notify-test.js (131 checks) and tests/mythos-bridge-whatsapp-resilience-test.js (95 checks); no real message sent by either.
records.othmode_usage: GitHub bridge terminal-state notifications only. Explicitly NOT MYTHOS AUTO WhatsApp / customer chat; every adapter implements sendText and nothing else.
records.verdict: BUILD the adapter boundary (about 400 lines, no dependency) + ADOPT Evolution API as the default runtime provider, PROVISIONALLY. Search First evidence: no existing MYTHOS component sends WhatsApp; the nearest reusable pattern is the orchestrator ntfy notify() boundary (projects/mythos-orchestrator/runner.js), whose always-non-fatal semantics were adopted and strengthened into a two-phase enqueue/flush design. MultiWA and WaSphere could not be identified as maintained projects without network access and are therefore not eligible to be a default. gh-issue-147 re-applied the same criterion to wa-evolution and WAHA and reached the same answer for the same reason — no network — so the decision is UNCHANGED: keep Evolution API, do not replace it on unverified grounds, and spend the effort removing the coupling instead. Adopting a verified candidate later now costs an environment variable, not a project.
records.before_deployment: A networked session MUST live-verify licence, maintenance status and real memory footprint for the chosen provider, and MUST re-open the choice if the footprint is incompatible with this VPS (measured 2026-09-03 21:06 UTC: swap 4095/4095 MiB fully consumed, 1781 MiB RAM available, 4 vCPU, / 83% full; the deploy user CAN now reach the Docker daemon, which was not true on 2026-09-02, so resources rather than permissions are the decisive constraint). Resolve the swap exhaustion (gh-issue-144 session guard, written but NOT installed) BEFORE deploying any gateway; then measure the candidate under a hard --memory cap for a week rather than trusting a README; then drive it through providers/generic.js against a local recorder; then the single controlled real smoke test: mythos-github-bridge notify-test --confirm. No auto-merge, no automatic production deployment.

final_review: 2026-08-26 final Search First re-check: every manually built capability (evolution store, sessions, detectors, export) was re-searched against GitHub/PyPI/npm/MCP/Anthropic Skills; no maintained project matched the constraints (zero-dependency Node, fail-closed store semantics, no-exec runtime, GPL exclusion) better than the ~1.5k lines built — verdicts recorded per record above; no dependency added to inflate the registry.
